description: The characters paired typing pairs. The engine owns the table (paired_typing/pairs.rs PAIRS: backtick, *, ~, and [ with its closing ]). Android keeps a copy (EditorEngineKeyboard.kt PAIR_KEYS) to split a keyboard's autocorrect commit that ends in a pair character into the word and the paired key; the engine cannot see a composition's commit as typing. A new pair in PAIRS changes its length, so the pattern below stops matching and this gate fails until the Android set is updated in the same commit.
